## Key ideas {#ss2-key-ideas .series-key-ideas}

- $a_n$ is a **term**; $S_n$ is the **sum of the first $n$ terms**.
- Sigma notation specifies the expression and the **included indices**.
- Recover terms using $a_1=S_1$ and $a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}$ for $n\ge2$.

::: {.takeaway}
If $S_{10}=120$ and $S_9=101$, what does their difference represent?
:::

::: {.fragment}
$$S_{10}-S_9=19=a_{10}$$

It is the tenth **term**, not the sum of ten terms.
:::
